title: Efficient Inference for Initiation-Window Risk with Delayed Entry and Smooth Censoring
banked_reason: D-0.5 NO-PASS after angle 0 exhausted five revisions; reviewer: the load-bearing condition β>3+2(a+b) is an instrumental high-smoothness restriction that does not establish registry/IUI applicability.
proof_attempt_summary: Five D-0.5 revisions tested a fixed-window delayed-entry inference proposal; a weighted L² remainder argument reduced the required smoothness from β > 9 + 2p to β > 3 + 2(a+b), but the final reviewer still rejected its claimed registry/IUI applicability. The supervisor directed angle give-up at the exhausted revision cap, producing NO-PASS. The mathematical kernel was not refuted; a lower-smoothness zero-intensity learner is unproved, and channel-specific Hölder domains remain to be specified.
tldr: For the fixed normalized natural-hazard initiation-window observed-law risk, the project separates the regular-information class \(q+1>a+b\) from the divergent-bracket complement. On the uniform-margin subclass, a measurable five-channel delayed-entry spline likelihood learner has truth-referenced prediction loss \(\mathcal L_{\mu,0}=O_P\{\operatorname{polylog}(n)(J^3/n+J^{-\beta})\}\). Exact fitted-martingale expansion and first-cell channelwise Gram comparisons yield \(|R_h|\le CJ^{a+b}(\mathcal L_{\mu,0}+J^{-2\beta})\), influence-score recovery, and efficient studentized Wald coverage under the explicit sufficient condition \(\beta>3+2(a+b)\). Under the separately maintained causal-correspondence equality, coverage of the equal causal risk follows by substitution and creates no additional solve target. The remaining open construction is a globally range-constrained quantized upper spline approximant valid at zero residual hazards.
gap: The published normalized-window one-step theorem permits flexible nuisance estimation but assumes a negligible product remainder; it does not provide a measurable delayed-entry learner or derive that remainder and empirical variance consistency from five truth-referenced occupation losses when initiation mass and censor retention vanish jointly.
fill: The project couples the corrected canonical score with a finite likelihood learner, an exact cutoff-aware and fixed-\(x\) drift identity, sharp channelwise first-cell Gram transfers, \(|R_h|\le CJ^s(\mathcal L_{\mu,0}+\epsilon^2)\), fitted-score recovery, empirical variance consistency, and uniform studentized efficiency under \(\beta>3+2s\). Under causal correspondence, coverage of the equal causal risk is only a substitution corollary of the observed-law theorem.
